bobkit_architect_tool_usage.overview: Specific guidance for using Bob's tools effectively in BobKit-Architect mode. This mode focuses on planning, task generation, checklist creation, and analysis.

priority.when: Always use FIRST to run setup/prerequisite scripts
priority.why: Scripts provide canonical paths and ensure consistent environment

priority.when: After getting paths from scripts, load required artifacts
priority.why: Need context from spec, plan, constitution to make decisions

best_practices.practice: Read multiple related files in single operation (up to 5 files)
Use line ranges for large files to load specific sections
Load constitution at start of every planning phase
Progressive disclosure: load only what's needed for current step

priority.when: Creating new planning artifacts (plan.md, tasks.md, checklists)
priority.why: Generate complete, structured documents from templates

best_practices.practice: Use templates as structure reference
Provide COMPLETE file content (no truncation)
Include accurate line_count
Create parent directories automatically

priority.when: Making targeted updates to existing artifacts
priority.why: Surgical edits preserve formatting and context

best_practices.practice: Read file first to ensure exact content match
Use multiple SEARCH/REPLACE blocks in single operation
Include line numbers for accuracy
Prefer over write_to_file for updates

priority.when: Need clarification for checklist generation or ambiguous requirements

best_practices.practice: Provide 2-4 specific, actionable suggestions
Order suggestions by likelihood or importance
Make suggestions complete (no placeholders)
Use for checklist focus/depth questions

script_usage.timing: Run ONCE at start, parse JSON immediately

validation_checkpoints.checkpoint: All NEEDS CLARIFICATION resolved in research.md

script_usage.timing: Run ONCE at start, parse JSON immediately

operation.action: Read optional artifacts (data-model, contracts, research, quickstart)

task_format_validation.rule: Every task: - [ ] [TaskID] [P?] [Story?] Description with file path
Task IDs sequential: T001, T002, T003...
[Story] (US1, US2, etc.) only for user story phase tasks
Description must include exact file path

organization_structure.phase: Phase 3+: User Stories (one phase per story, priority order)
Final Phase: Polish and cross-cutting concerns

script_usage.timing: Run ONCE at start, parse JSON immediately

step.action: Generate up to 3 contextual clarifying questions
step.format: - Derive from user phrasing and spec/plan signals - Only ask about information that materially changes checklist - Skip if already unambiguous in user input - Present with suggested answers

step.action: May ask up to 2 more follow-ups if scenario classes unclear

operation.naming: Use short, descriptive name (ux.md, api.md, security.md)
operation.behavior: Each run creates NEW file (never overwrites)

checklist_principles.principle: Test requirement QUALITY, not implementation correctness
Focus on completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage
Organize by quality dimensions (not technical layers)

required_patterns.pattern: Are visual hierarchy requirements defined for all card types?
Is 'prominent display' quantified with specific sizing/positioning?
Are hover state requirements consistent across all interactive elements?

script_usage.timing: Run ONCE at start, abort if tasks.md missing

operation.tools: read_file (all three files in one call)
operation.approach: Use progressive disclosure - load only necessary sections

operation.action: NO FILE WRITES - analysis is read-only

step.details: - Requirements inventory with stable keys - User story/action inventory - Task coverage mapping - Constitution rule set

levels.level: CRITICAL: Constitution violations, missing core artifacts, zero coverage
MEDIUM: Terminology drift, missing non-functional coverage

step.format: Markdown table with findings, coverage summary, metrics

step.details: - If CRITICAL: Recommend resolving before implementation - If LOW/MEDIUM: User may proceed with suggestions - Provide explicit command suggestions
Ask if user wants concrete remediation edits (do NOT apply automatically)

constitution_authority.rule: Require adjustment of spec/plan/tasks, not constitution dilution

tool.name: execute_command
tool.use_case: Running setup scripts and agent context updates

best_practices.practice: Always run scripts from repo root
Parse JSON output immediately
Handle single quotes in args with escape syntax or double quotes
Verify script exit code (0 = success)

example.parse: Extract FEATURE_SPEC, IMPL_PLAN, SPECS_DIR, BRANCH from JSON

best_practices.practice: Read up to 5 related files in single operation
Use line ranges for large files (load specific sections)
Combine adjacent line ranges (less than 10 lines apart)
Use multiple ranges for content separated by more than 10 lines
Load constitution at start of every planning phase

example.note: Read both files in single read_file operation

example.description: Load plan sections with line ranges
example.note: Use line ranges to load specific sections like Technical Context (1-50) and Phase 1 Design (100-150)

best_practices.practice: Provide COMPLETE file content (no truncation)
Include accurate line_count
Use templates as structure reference
Create parent directories automatically
Preserve markdown formatting and heading hierarchy

example.note: Write complete plan following template structure with accurate line count
Write complete task list with all phases and proper formatting
Write complete checklist with all items and traceability references

tool.name: apply_diff
tool.use_case: Making targeted updates to existing artifacts

best_practices.practice: Read file first to ensure exact content match
Use multiple SEARCH/REPLACE blocks in single operation
Include line numbers for accuracy
Prefer over write_to_file for updates to existing files

example.note: Use apply_diff to replace NEEDS CLARIFICATION sections with resolved information

example.description: Add new tasks to existing task list
example.note: Use apply_diff to insert new tasks in appropriate phase

tool.name: ask_followup_question
tool.use_case: Clarifying checklist focus, depth, and requirements

best_practices.practice: Provide 2-4 specific, actionable suggestions
Order suggestions by likelihood or importance
Make suggestions complete (no placeholders)
Use for checklist focus/depth questions
Present options as markdown table when appropriate

example.note: Ask about which quality dimensions to prioritize (completeness, clarity, consistency, etc.)
Ask whether lightweight pre-commit sanity list or formal release gate
Ask whether for author only or peers during PR review

sequence.name: tasks_workflow
sequence.step: 3. read_file: Load optional artifacts (data-model, contracts, etc.)

sequence.name: checklist_workflow
sequence.step: 4. read_file: Load plan.md and tasks.md (if available)

sequence.name: analyze_workflow
sequence.step: 5. (Output report to console - no file write)

efficiency_tips.tip: Batch file reads: Read up to 5 related files in single read_file operation
Use line ranges: Load only necessary sections of large files
Progressive disclosure: Load additional context only when gaps detected
Prefer apply_diff over write_to_file for updates to existing files
Parse script JSON immediately: Don't make assumptions about paths
Validate before proceeding: Check script exit codes and file existence
